title: Hearing Louis Armstrong on the radio in the 1930s
summary: He did not see Armstrong at the Astoria in 1936 but heard him on the radio from the whites-only Suburban club.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: But you see when Louis came back in 1936 did you see him he was at the Astoria
No, I didn't see him then. See in fact
I don't know how you may have been too young to him.

Well, yeah at that time I was 14 years of age 13, 14 years of age but I knew of Louis Armstrong and I heard him on the radio when he played the suburban club up here where they wouldn't let no blacks in it was only for white folks up here in Jefferson.
